parameters.query: SELECT config_revision, chat_model, embedding_model, embedding_profile_id, embedding_dimension, ai_timeout_max FROM rag.rag_settings WHERE id = 1

INSERT INTO rag.corpus_versions (corpus_version, status, document_count, chunk_count, embedding_profile_id) VALUES ($1, 'staging', $2, $3, $4) ON CONFLICT (corpus_version) DO UPDATE SET document_count = EXCLUDED.document_count, chunk_count = EXCLUDED.chunk_count, embedding_profile_id = EXCLUDED.embedding_profile_id, status = CASE WHEN rag.corpus_versions.status = 'failed' THEN 'staging' ELSE rag.corpus_versions.status END, failed_at = CASE WHEN rag.corpus_versions.status = 'failed' THEN NULL ELSE rag.corpus_versions.failed_at END, failure_reason = CASE WHEN rag.corpus_versions.status = 'failed' THEN NULL ELSE rag.corpus_versions.failure_reason END WHERE rag.corpus_versions.embedding_profile_id = EXCLUDED.embedding_profile_id RETURNING corpus_version, status, document_count, chunk_count, embedding_profile_id

WITH inserted AS (INSERT INTO rag.documents (corpus_version, source_name, source_hash, chunk_index, content, embedding, embedding_profile_id, metadata) SELECT $1, c.source_name, c.source_hash, c.chunk_index, c.content, c.embedding::text::vector, c.embedding_profile_id, jsonb_build_object('source_name', c.source_name, 'source_hash', c.source_hash, 'chunk_index', c.chunk_index, 'corpus_version', $1, 'embedding_profile_id', c.embedding_profile_id) FROM jsonb_to_recordset($2::jsonb) AS c(source_name text, source_hash text, chunk_index integer, content text, embedding jsonb, embedding_profile_id text) ON CONFLICT (corpus_version, source_hash, chunk_index) DO NOTHING RETURNING id) SELECT $1::text AS corpus_version, $3::text AS embedding_profile_id, (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM inserted) AS inserted_chunk_count

SELECT cv.corpus_version, cv.status, cv.document_count, cv.chunk_count, cv.embedding_profile_id, count(d.id)::integer AS persisted_chunk_count, count(DISTINCT d.source_name)::integer AS persisted_document_count FROM rag.corpus_versions cv LEFT JOIN rag.documents d ON d.corpus_version = cv.corpus_version WHERE cv.corpus_version = $1 AND cv.embedding_profile_id = $2 GROUP BY cv.corpus_version, cv.status, cv.document_count, cv.chunk_count, cv.embedding_profile_id

BEGIN; UPDATE rag.corpus_versions SET status = 'superseded' WHERE status = 'active' AND corpus_version <> $1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rag.corpus_versions candidate WHERE candidate.corpus_version = $1 AND candidate.status IN ('staging', 'active') AND candidate.embedding_profile_id = $2 AND candidate.chunk_count = (SELECT count(*) FROM rag.documents d WHERE d.corpus_version = candidate.corpus_version) AND candidate.document_count = (SELECT count(DISTINCT d.source_name) FROM rag.documents d WHERE d.corpus_version = candidate.corpus_version)); UPDATE rag.corpus_versions candidate SET status = 'active', activated_at = COALESCE(candidate.activated_at, now()), failed_at = NULL, failure_reason = NULL WHERE candidate.corpus_version = $1 AND candidate.status IN ('staging', 'active') AND candidate.embedding_profile_id = $2 AND candidate.chunk_count = (SELECT count(*) FROM rag.documents d WHERE d.corpus_version = candidate.corpus_version) AND candidate.document_count = (SELECT count(DISTINCT d.source_name) FROM rag.documents d WHERE d.corpus_version = candidate.corpus_version); UPDATE rag.rag_settings SET active_corpus_version = $1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = 1 AND embedding_profile_id = $2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rag.corpus_versions candidate WHERE candidate.corpus_version = $1 AND candidate.status = 'active' AND candidate.embedding_profile_id = $2 AND candidate.chunk_count = (SELECT count(*) FROM rag.documents d WHERE d.corpus_version = candidate.corpus_version) AND candidate.document_count = (SELECT count(DISTINCT d.source_name) FROM rag.documents d WHERE d.corpus_version = candidate.corpus_version)); COMMIT;
UPDATE rag.corpus_versions SET status = 'failed', failed_at = now(), failure_reason = $2 WHERE corpus_version = $1 AND status = 'staging'
